requirement: Visible, correctly scaled prisoner in all three enabled scenes
acceptance: QA-01: body visible in ordinary open space after startup, activity exit and load; near-wall recovery verified in Unity.

requirement: Grounded walking, jogging, sprinting, reversal, stairs and slopes
acceptance: QA-02 at 30/60/120 FPS: no residual wall push, unintended flight or floor penetration.

requirement: Jump, crouch, ceiling clearance and low-bank exit control
acceptance: QA-02/05: clear body space required for standing/clamber; deliberate jumps remain controllable.

requirement: Recent sprint memory, transitions and foot contact
acceptance: Immediate sprint release uses RunStop; sprint followed by 30 seconds walking uses ordinary stop; review sliding in Unity.

requirement: Licensed extended movement, swimming and combat animation set
acceptance: Record provenance and measured motion; review lateral, crouch, jump, swim and attack clips with the existing controller.

requirement: Living standing actors supported on the intended local floor
acceptance: QA-03 on every route/tier: no roof/table snaps; seated, sleeping and dead actors retain their states.

requirement: One camera owner through activities, cinematics and vehicles
acceptance: QA-01/07: no persistent inside-head view or competing driver after returning to gameplay.

requirement: Exploration firearm hits and ammunition/reload ownership
acceptance: QA-04: muzzle obstruction, self-hit and reload/swap checks; no accidental story firearm unlock.

requirement: Exploration knife/punch contact and NPC damage
acceptance: QA-04: standing/seated NPC contacts happen once at the correct time; stamina and lethal routine cleanup agree.

requirement: Surface swimming, dry-shore clamber and safe boat exit
acceptance: QA-05: surface support and solid collision; only a clear low bank permits clamber.

requirement: Sampled offshore warning, then WANTED and restart
acceptance: QA-05: swimming/boat warning beyond the 24 m sample band and restriction beyond 40 m; no pursuit claim.

requirement: 100% health, damage, DEAD and full-health restart
acceptance: QA-06: 3 active seconds before restart; latest safe checkpoint preserved; pause stops the timer.

requirement: Poker, training and vehicle control-state restoration
acceptance: QA-07: every legal exit restores control, camera and activity state; boarded vehicle visibility follows its documented contract.

requirement: Flyable helicopter and buoyant patrol boat
acceptance: QA-07: safe boarding/exits, shore/obstacle collision, pause and activity cleanup.

requirement: Animated police rig and matching equipment fit
acceptance: Record licensed rig/animations; fit gear; verify idle/walk without floating or clipping torso equipment.

requirement: Authored reactions for proposed escape encounters
acceptance: Implement bounded encounter cues and mission failure; do not imply a general police pursuit simulation.

requirement: Complete Chapter 01 arrival-to-agreement path
acceptance: QA-10: complete critical path and missed-knife retry; all 19 stages and their required flags remain reachable.

requirement: Chapter 02 blueprint and service-passage missions
acceptance: Implement 02A/02B with explicit quest items, doors, checkpoints and no skipped progression gates.

requirement: Boat escape corridor and complete ending
acceptance: QA-13: valid extraction only; clear corridor exemption on abort, death, load and scene change.

requirement: Correct Five-card draw text/audio to Texas Hold’em
acceptance: Welcome text, subtitles, regenerated audio and help agree with the four-player Texas Hold’em implementation.

requirement: Ten functional pause pages and truthful live values
acceptance: QA-09: mouse/keyboard/controller checks, confirmation focus and actual acquired inventory values.

requirement: Readable adaptive text and focus at 4K and narrow aspect ratios
acceptance: QA-09: no clipped or unreachable actions; scalable typography and safe margins; do not assume portrait reflow.

requirement: Latest checkpoint plus three manual slots with validated restore
acceptance: QA-08: backup, corrupt, unsafe and context tests; disclose exploration world-state persistence limits.

requirement: Shared High/Ultra and native 1440p/4K settings
acceptance: QA-09/11: display reopening, saved presets and pipeline teardown; successful Unity API/shader compilation.

requirement: Post-processing/shadow resources and environment-reflective water
acceptance: QA-11: saved active SSAO, correct reflections/depth and no pink materials after scene travel.

requirement: Profile and optimize a high-end 1440p/4K route
acceptance: Record actual PC, resolution, preset, p95 frame time and RAM/VRAM; meet agreed targets before advertising.

requirement: Cohesive scale, material and LOD pass on one complete route
acceptance: Review equipment fit, UV/PBR/light consistency; preserve provenance and document actual imported texture dimensions.

requirement: Spatial footstep, combat, dialogue and UI audio hooks
acceptance: QA-11: listening, mix, pause, occlusion and listener checks; source hooks alone are not audible approval.

requirement: Licensed helicopter/boat loops and transitions
acceptance: Review audible start, idle, load, stop and loop transitions at near/far distances.

requirement: Nine primary and 29 extra catalog entries
acceptance: Review prefab dependencies, placement, collision and actual capabilities; do not assume explosion or radio playback systems.

requirement: Kodiak C70, abandoned garage and rusty-roof house imports
acceptance: Obtain usable archives within transfer constraints; complete reliable import and placement before changing blocked status.

requirement: Release asset-rights and attribution register
acceptance: Every distributed asset has creator, actual license evidence, source hash and required credits.

requirement: Accessibility: remapping, text size, toggles and reduced shake
acceptance: Record each available option; verify keyboard/controller access, subtitle contrast and usability.

requirement: Localization beyond current English
acceptance: Externalize and translate text; define voice scope; add RTL layout if Arabic is selected and complete linguistic QA.

requirement: Hourly source-check reporting
acceptance: Observe published Actions runs and retained failure logs; do not imply unattended code fixes.

requirement: Reproducible tested Windows player and actual size report
acceptance: QA-12: clean-machine launch and actual BuildReport/download bytes; no artificial padding toward 10 GB.
